name: trained-assist-runner-jobs
description: Оркестрация GHA-джоб для ai-agent-runner: submit → stream events → result/artifacts (без продуктового кода)

scripts.check: npm run check:yaml && npm run check:syntax && npm run dry-run
scripts.check:syntax: for f in scripts/*.mjs scripts/e2e-loop/*.mjs scripts/e2e-loop/engine-scripts/*.mjs scripts/epic-stress/*.mjs scripts/epic-stress/blocks/*.mjs scripts/epic-stress/engine-scripts/*.mjs; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; node --check "$f" || exit 1; echo "node --check ok: $f"; done
scripts.dry-run: node scripts/stress-probe.mjs --dry-run && node scripts/e2e-loop.mjs --dry-run && node scripts/epic-stress.mjs --dry-run
